A single-bladed green '''lightsaber''' belonged to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]]. Though he preferred missions in the cockpit of his starfighter, he wielded the lightsaber with precision and great skill. The color of the blade switched from violet, cobalt and emerald.

==History==
Tiin would use this [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in a training match against [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] circa [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]] while the two debated about [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]]. 

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Tiin wielded this [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] during the battle on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] - the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|opening battle]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Ep II">{{Film|II}}</ref> During the war itself, Tiin used this weapon on a [[Mission to the Rig|mission]] to [[The Rig]] alongside [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]], and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]].<ref name="Republic 65">[[Republic 65|''Republic'' 65]]</ref>

Tiin most notably wielded the lightsaber during the [[Showdown on Coruscant]] where he, along with Jedi Masters Fisto, Kolar and Windu, confronted and were slain by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Ep III">{{Film|III}}</ref>

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Tiin's lightsaber, depicted with a [[Color/Legends|purple]] blade in the [[Star Wars (1998) 23|23rd]] and [[Star Wars (1998) 41|41st]] issues of [[Dark Horse Comics]]' [[Star Wars: Republic|''Star Wars'' series]],<ref name="SW23" /><ref name="SW41">[[Star Wars (1998) 41|''Star Wars'' (1998) 41]]</ref> was recolored green when the issues were reprinted in ''[[Star Wars Omnibus: Quinlan Vos: Jedi in Darkness]]''.<ref name="Omnivos">''[[Star Wars Omnibus: Quinlan Vos: Jedi in Darkness]]''</ref>
